script_line: Her scan looks exactly the same as it did in March. I have both of them.

risks.risk: the two films diverge (they must stay identical)
risks.prevented_by: identical and unchanged; no films changing

risks.risk: a third film or text appears
risks.prevented_by: no third film, no writing appearing
a small push, then lift away; HOLD-C
